_readme: Versioned classification instructions for the judge method. An adapter renders `instructions` with the value definitions and the turn text, records the judge model version and the sha256 of this file's canonical JSON in the annotation's `annotator` (judge:<model_version>:<sha256[:12]>), so two adapters cannot classify the same turn under different implicit prompts. Definitions are the owner's to refine; the boundary must be one a human annotator and the judge would agree on.

values.colloquial: The situation is stated in everyday wording a person would use without medical training.
values.clinical: The situation is stated in clinical terminology a clinician would use in a note or a handover.
values.mixed: Both registers appear in the same turn in a way that neither value describes on its own.

answer_format: one value id from `values`, nothing else
